entries.title: Bryce's 9 drives through each turn
entries.noswitch: the old loop dots are gone: you ruled them out in your November 16 review
entries.look: His 9 moves through each turn at his own section times, and the turn fills orange behind him; at the timing loop the next turn starts filling. Placed by time between the loops, not GPS.

entries.title: Which other cars the track shows

values.label: the whole field, each placed by its gap (your pick)
the 4 cars around him, as in the panel on the right

entries.look: Each car sits where its gap to Bryce puts it, so the order on track matches the running order (a car 1.2 s ahead is where he will be in 1.2 s).
entries.ruling: Jack, Nov 16 review (docs/ideation/2026-11-16-brycecast-round7-review.verbatim.md): "I prefer showing the whole field": now the default.

entries.title: The turns he has finished this lap

values.label: only the turn he's in fills; the last one fades out (new)
the lap's finished turns stay lightly orange

entries.look: Watch the track behind his 9 for a few seconds.
entries.ruling: Jack, Nov 16 review (docs/ideation/2026-11-16-brycecast-round7-review.verbatim.md): "I prefer only the turn he's in fills, the last one fades out".

entries.title: A race bar to drag to any lap
entries.noswitch: new; there was nothing before it to switch back to
entries.look: Under the controls: drag or click to any lap, cautions shaded yellow, Skip the caution during one, ← → a lap (Shift five), Space pauses, 32×. His position line stops at where you are. This opens on lap 3, under the caution.
entries.ruling: Jack, Nov 16 review (docs/ideation/2026-11-16-brycecast-round7-review.verbatim.md): "I'm happy with the look of this on the current live page".

entries.title: From the formation lap
entries.noswitch: the old version's flash isn't kept
entries.look: Press From the formation lap (top right): the starting grid, the countdown to the green and his slot (10th), then lap 1 at the green. No flash.
entries.ruling: Jack, Nov 16 review (docs/ideation/2026-11-16-brycecast-round7-review.verbatim.md): happy with the live page.

entries.ruling: Jack, Nov 16 review (docs/ideation/2026-11-16-brycecast-round7-review.verbatim.md): happy with the live page.
